answer: Reputation decay taxes idle ones: each identity starts at 100, loses 8 per idle epoch after 2 idle ones, and below 60 loses rewards and weight; verified work restores 6 points per epoch. A walnut-hard log records each decay, a vertex of cross-checks links decayed identities sharing a funder, and the fable of cheap farming ends. Keeping 1,000 clones alive costs 3,000 units an epoch; a missed cycle wipes 8,000, while honest agents earn points back.
